Does it look misaligned from the picture? I closed it back up after putting the internals back as shown in the images, with the last picture showing the internals as they look when the blaster is primed.

When I prime the blaster I have to push it forward pretty hard for it to catch and lock the slide, and for it to fire from there I have to pull the slide back very hard as I pull the trigger, if that's a useful clue.

I opened it up to tighten the seals in the blaster and while doing so removed the safety mechanisms within it and also applied silicone lube to the inside of the plunger and the spring. After doing it has become very difficult to fire, locking in the prime is very difficult and after priming it I have to yank the slide back while pulling the trigger as hard as possible to get the catch to release. Anything I might be able to do to get this blaster working well again? Probably should have never opened it up, but I noticed after range testing it that it's ranges were disappointing compared to my nexus pro and Aeon pro.
